scenes.name: THE SEARCH BEGINS
scenes.desc: Frame 1 is the payoff: across his empty street a building-sized screen glitches on with HIS FACE and THE ENTIRE WORLD IS SEARCHING FOR YOU. He stands small beneath it, looking up. A fast push into the face on the screen, then a close-up of him staring up at it.
scenes.actions: The main character from Part 1, unchanged (only trainers added). Already stopped, staring up: disbelief, unease.
scenes.lighting: Cool blue-grey morning; the billboard floods his face with white-blue light.
scenes.sfx: A hard hit on frame 1 as the screen powers on (relay clunk, electrical hum, static), a riser and a big whoosh into the push.
scenes.edit: No build-up: the most striking image is the first frame. PART 2 in large type at the top from frame 1. Key caption THE WORLD IS SEARCHING. after the line lands.

scenes.name: GLOBAL ATTENTION
scenes.desc: A news presenter at the GLOBAL 24 desk with his photo behind her. The square's giant screens all show his face. Faces in the crowd look up. A government situation room: an URGENT message on the wall. Scientists at screens of worldwide disappearance data.
scenes.actions: The presenter talks; the crowd stares; officials lean over the table; scientists point at data.
scenes.lighting: Studio light; overcast daylight; red alert light in the situation room; blue lab light.
scenes.sfx: News stings, crowd murmur, notification pings, a teleprinter-like data chatter, a low bass pulse that grows.
scenes.edit: Quick cuts on the beat with glitches. Key captions: BILLIONS ARE WATCHING. / SCIENTISTS WANT ANSWERS.

scenes.name: THE INVITATION
scenes.desc: A black government vehicle with blue light strips glides up to his tower and its door opens. He walks into an enormous research facility: a holographic globe, walls of displays, scientists everywhere. In a glass research room the lead scientist welcomes him.
scenes.actions: He gets into the car, then walks in slowly, looking around; the scientist offers her hand and gestures to a seat.
scenes.lighting: Cool blue facility light with subtle purple; the hologram's glow.
scenes.sfx: A smooth electric vehicle arriving, a door sliding, footsteps on a polished floor, electronic doors, interface beeps.

shots.camera: huge reveal: crane up and back as he walks into the facility

scenes.name: SOMETHING IS DIFFERENT
scenes.desc: The lead scientist studies a massive digital timeline: one vertical spike - billions of people gone at exactly the same moment. Then her eyes narrow: one record does not fit. The screen highlights his photo: ANOMALY.
scenes.actions: She swipes the timeline, stops, leans closer.
scenes.lighting: The timeline's cyan light; a red highlight.
scenes.sfx: Interface swipes and beeps, a data-scan sweep, rising strings and bass.
scenes.edit: Music builds. Key caption: SOMETHING IS DIFFERENT.

scenes.name: THE CLIFFHANGER
scenes.desc: The scientist turns to him. The lights in the room dim. The giant screen shows a mysterious symbol. He looks confused. The screen glitches - PART 3?
scenes.actions: She turns slowly; he stares at the symbol, frowning, lips parted.
scenes.lighting: The room goes dark; the symbol's violet-white glow on his face.
scenes.sfx: Power-down thunk as the lights dim, a deep drone, the symbol's tone, a final digital glitch and silence.
scenes.edit: Slow pushes; a hard glitch to black; PART 3? Key caption: PART 3?

lines.text: 4 billion people are searching for one man... you.

lines.text: Your face is on every news channel. Governments are sending messages, and scientists desperately want answers.

lines.text: Suddenly, you're invited to the most important scientific meeting in human history. Everyone wants answers, but you have absolutely no idea what happened.
